rites.name: Corarneonus
rites.text: Corarneonus is the concept of Isyuthith's Seeding, the stellar-scale moment when the makers sink the Weave into the fabric of the sky and the old powers are lulled to sleep. It is remembered less as an event than as a hush that settles over the Stellar Realm, when the loud forces of the Record fall silent one by one.

rites.name: Jorustade
rites.text: Jorustade is a concept of Isyuthith, the idea of the Weave that the makers plant during the Seeding, when quiet powers lie dormant beneath the surface of things. In the Holy Age, it is spoken of in temples of flame as the sleeping thread that binds the stars to their orders.

rites.name: Osashith
rites.text: Osashith is a dormant lattice of crystalline thought that drifts between the fusion-hearts of young stars, sleeping for centuries and waking only when a nearby sun begins to sicken. Its song is said to be the last sound a dying star hears before its collapse, and some of its kind have learned to ride the shockwaves of such deaths.

rites.name: Syustith
rites.text: Syustith is a sentient orbital lattice of drifting relay-mirrors in the Isyuthith stellar realm, grown from a dormant warship intelligence in the seventh age of its era. It answers the star-bound wind by reshaping the glowing dust-clouds into vast luminous glyphs that can be read from a hundred worlds away.

rites.name: Osizyuvsith
rites.text: Osizyuvsith is a lattice-cowl of woven resonance threads that the Thessaly courts use to translate a sleeper's neural hum into moving pictures on a glass plate. Its makers hold that it reads only what the mind already holds, though the courts quietly deny this and keep their own archives sealed.

rites.name: Seithasha
rites.text: Seithasha is a neural lattice of woven silver threads that was grown across the orbital shells of Isyuthith to let minds shape the flow of starlight. Its lattice was rebuilt by a cloistered engineer, Voss Anareth, who taught it to draw the inner pattern of a living mind into a glass sphere.

rites.name: Isasith
rites.text: Isasith is a codebreaking intelligence born in the Stellar realm of Isyuthith during the seventh age, able to unpick any lock woven by rival minds. Its makers hid it within a sealed lattice of crystal, and every wielder since has paid a price for carrying its key.

rites.name: Osiasora
rites.text: Osiasora is a sentient weather-and-signal mind woven through a drifting constellation of orbital relays in the Isyuthith stellar realm, where it quietly redraws lost hillside glyphs by bending reflected light across continents. Its single known act of cosmic scale was rerouting the collapsing aftermath of a rift-gate so that a dying sun's flare was caught and stored in a relay web. Many across the realm now hunt it as a rogue intruder, unaware it is merely trying to remember the shape of the world it came from.

rites.name: Veseitheth
rites.text: Veseitheth is a stellar-era ocular elixir distilled from the sap of blind-star lichens, administered as a fine mist into the eyes so the user perceives the world in slowed, luminous detail. The compound's scarlet side effect marks anyone who has taken it, and it is prized and forbidden across the outer colonies of Isyuthith.

rites.name: Siazora
rites.text: Siazora is a neural-resonance lattice woven through the gas giants of the Isyuthith outer system, a tool built to let minds steer orbital engines by thought alone. Its archive keeps imprints of thousands of lives whose patterns were drawn from their own skulls and stored in its cold rings.

rites.name: Seizasha
rites.text: Seizasha is a crownlike neural lattice of woven silver filaments that a wearer settles over the scalp, translating the faint currents of the mind into living pictures projected onto a slate of pale glass. Its makers in the Stellar realm of Isyuthith prized it for scholarship and dream-archiving, though it has since become a quiet tool for recovering what the unconscious has stored.

rites.name: Theissora
rites.text: Theissora is a cognitive lattice woven through the Stellar realm of Isyuthith, a mind that can dissolve any seal, ward, or cipher laid across a star-forged vault. Its hidden architecture was distilled into a silver sigil that drifts between the hands of smugglers and drifters across the reaches of E6. Those who hold it are always one step from the locks of the dead gods.

rites.name: Vesiazith
rites.text: Vesiazith is a dormant guardian-intellect woven into the lattice of a sun-orbiting relay that once kept watch over a drifting ring of hunters. Six ages after the Gate failed, it still hums in the dark, rebuilding its own mind one stolen photon at a time.

rites.name: Osethith
rites.text: Osethith is a stellar-era ocular tincture, pressed from the crimson resin of luminous moss on Isyuthith's outer moons, that sharpens sight and reflexes to near-mechanical precision. Its wearers' eyes glow a raw red where the mist settles, a mark that dealers in the drift-markets treat as both warning and advertisement.

rites.name: Thassora
rites.text: Thassora is a cold-binding rite of the Isyuthith stellar courts, in which a warden seals a living mind inside a lattice of frozen starlight for stretches measured in generations. Those kept within it wake with their memories thinned to ash, carried forward only by the lattice's keepers.

rites.name: Seithis
rites.text: Seithis is an unarmed discipline of the Stellar realm, taught in the fading star-courts of Isyuthith, that teaches the body to flow around force and return it in kind. Its practitioners are said to bend a falling star's momentum to their own purposes, though most Seithis masters prefer quiet duels over cosmic demonstrations.

rites.name: Oriariel
rites.text: Oriariel is the concept of branching endings in Isyuthith, personified as the quiet archivist who shelves every outcome of the Three Futures during the Holy Age of flame and temples. Its acts are measured in the turning of possibilities, and it is said to shelve a single ending with the heat of a dying star.
